ctaHeading: Ready for your Meadow Heights carpentry project?
aboutText: Brown Brothers Constructions has been serving Meadow Heights for over 20 years, specialising in high-quality carpentry. Our team is dedicated to craftsmanship and customer satisfaction. From custom furniture to full home renovations, we bring expertise and local knowledge to every project in the area.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of carpentry services tailored to Meadow Heights homes and businesses. Our skilled team handles everything from structural work to fine finishing, ensuring top-notch results every time.

services.title: Custom Furniture Making

services.title: Structural Framing
services.desc: Expert framing for new builds and extensions, ensuring structural integrity and compliance.
